Nina Rao: Hi team — hiring manager Sam asking for a one-time sign-on of $7,500 split 5k on acceptance and 2.5k after start to cover delayed relocation reimbursements. start target 2026-06-15. Is this an exception?

People Ops: Yes, split payments are exceptions. Please open Offer Exception and include comp band, base, business justification and retention tie.

Hiring Manager - Sam: Band L3, base $120k. Reason: candidate needs immediate funds to secure lease; remaining amount delayed due to vendor timing. Manager proposes 6-month retention check.

CompOps Bot: EXC-2026-172 created, pending comp committee review.

Benefits: Note: if start 2026-06-15 benefits eligibility may begin 07-01 depending on location; confirm if candidate needs retroactive coverage.

Payroll: Payroll needs 10 business days lead time for each payment and will code as two taxable lump sums. Finance sign-off required to hold FY funds for deferred portion.

People Ops: Route steps: 1) submit EXC form; 2) tag @CompOps and @Finance; 3) People Ops triage and request retention metric; 4) comp committee decision; 5) if approved create payroll ticket with exact dates.

Nina Rao: Submitted EXC-2026-172 and added manager retention note. Can comp committee aim for decision by 2026-06-01? Manager needs to extend offer same week.

People Ops: Marked expedited. Will ping comp chair for 48h turnaround and post update here.

Hiring Manager - Sam: thanks — will loop candidate and hold offer until approval.
